redVitalia: **Adaptar:** una acción principal inequívoca como “Contact”, manteniendo una sola ruta dominante por landing.
**Adaptar:** convertir la reversión de riesgo visible en una condición contractual medible, no en una promesa ambigua.
**Copiar con control:** presentar casos con cliente, periodo, inversión, denominador y resultado; distinguir siempre datos autodeclarados de auditoría independiente.
**Copiar:** responder objeciones de precio, plazo, permanencia y resultados antes del CTA de alto compromiso.
**Probar:** WhatsApp como vía rápida, con consentimiento, SLA de respuesta y trazabilidad en CRM.
**Replicar la disciplina de medición:** el stack público detectado (WordPress, WhatsApp) indica una captación instrumentada; RedVitalia debe mantener atribución de fuente a venta.

pricing: Exact current package price not reverified

contract: Matched leads are automatically sent and charged
A matching provider cannot decline before deduction

guarantee: Marketing uses strong ROI language, while FAQ and terms do not guarantee jobs, sales or lead volume.

proof: No independent audit of ROI was visible on the reviewed path
contradictions: guarantee-conflict — This is a material conflict between acquisition copy and legal reality. — The landing uses guaranteed ROI, guaranteed results and risk-free language. — FAQ and terms do not guarantee jobs, sales or lead volume.

credit-expiry-conflict — Credit persistence is internally inconsistent. — FAQ and parts of the terms say credits do not expire. — The terms also say a pause longer than 14 days can forfeit remaining credits.
localization-error — The currency mismatch signals recycled copy and reduces trust. — A South African page referred to every pound spent. — The market uses South African rand.
pricing-drift — Do not publish it as current without a dated live source. — A prior dataset referenced R45. — That exact current unit price was not confirmed.
inferences: Automatic deduction transfers matching risk from the marketplace to the provider. — confidence: high — basis: Terms state that a matched lead is sent and charged without a pre-acceptance choice.
The recredit documentation burden is designed to limit refund leakage. — confidence: high — basis: Call recordings, screenshots and multiple attempts are required for some disputes.
limitations: No form or WhatsApp action was completed.
Pricing was not currently public enough to reverify the historical figure.
Outcome claims were not independently audited.

copy: Audit landing claims against FAQ and terms
Define a lead as a request for quote rather than a sale
avoid: Guaranteed ROI language when terms reject outcomes
Automatic deduction hidden in fine print
test: Pre-acceptance lead preview versus automatic delivery
A simple dispute workflow with visible evidence requirements
